verses.1: I came to my sister’s house. I ate with her, my beloved wife. I drank wine with my milk. My enemies drank it, and they paid for it with their lives.
verses.2: I am tired, and my heart is filled with sorrow. My brother, please open my door for me. My sister, please help me. My soul is filled with pain; my body is broken into pieces.
verses.3: I stripped off my clothes, I washed my feet thoroughly.
verses.4: My Lord has stretched out His hand from above, from the heavens, and laid His hands upon Him.
verses.5: I stand here to open for my father. My hands are covered in wounds, and my wrists are also injured.
verses.6: I opened my mouth to speak to my father. But my father was too stubborn. My heart tried to speak through me, but I couldn’t find any words to say. I called out to him, but he didn’t respond.
verses.7: You have found me, the prisoners. In the city of Hikuni, they wounded me. They took my clothes away from me, from the store where I was kept.
verses.8: I thank you, daughters of Jerusalem! If you find my husband, tell him that I am sick in love.
verses.9: How beautiful are those women who are like flowers! How beautiful are those women whose beauty has been preserved through time.
verses.10: My God is pure and holy; Adam is also pure from all impurities.
verses.11: Its head was covered with black hairs that resembled fur.
verses.12: His eyes were like those of a bird that flew over the waves, with milk-like liquid flowing from them.
verses.13: For his life, like a bunch of rotten leaves from tall trees, his lips are rotten and decayed.
verses.14: His hands were covered with golden rings, filled with precious gems. His fingers were adorned with sapphires.
verses.15: Their heads are like those of six men, standing on the shoulders of a giant. They look like little boys, like those who are pure and holy.
verses.16: They wait patiently, and they all become satisfied. This is my father, and this is my brother; they are daughters of Jerusalem.
